description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the acquisitions of the lands in Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically dealing with compensation deposits for state-acquired land where no claimants appeared. The content includes detailed descriptions of land parcels (location, name, lot numbers, extent) and financial compensation matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
